arguments.heading: What happened at the argument
paragraphs: Mr. Metzler argued the homeowner consented to entry. He said no reasonable officer would doubt this.
Mr. Stirba argued the entry was constitutional. He said no clear law was violated.
Mr. Stewart argued the entry was constitutional. He asked the Court to change the decision order.

sections.heading: What this case is about
paragraphs: This case tests the legal shield for police officers. It asks if a general rule protects them. It also asks if a specific court ruling is required.
